cards.t: Deutsche Bank Nears Launch of Institutional Bitcoin and Ether Custody Services
cards.b: Deutsche Bank is weeks away from launching institutional Bitcoin and Ether custody services in Germany and expanding to Asian financial centers.

per.BTC: Institutional custody launch broadens regulated access.
per.ETH: Custody support from a major bank expands institutional pathways.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST

cards.t: MSCI Finalizes Index Rules Threatening Strategy and Metaplanet Inclusion
cards.b: MSCI approved rules classifying non-operating companies whose balance sheets are dominated by a single asset as ineligible for index inclusion, threatening the index status of Bitcoin treasury firms like Strategy and Metaplanet.

per.BTC: Potential index exclusion for corporate holders could weigh on institutional sentiment.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact names of all affected companies outside Strategy and Metaplanet.

cards.t: XRP Ledger Escrow Release Scheduled for November 1
cards.b: An escrow release of XRP is scheduled for November 1, adding a planned supply influx into the market.

per.XRP: Scheduled token unlock may increase circulating supply and selling pressure.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact token volume to be released.

cards.t: Crypto Firms Launch Quantum Alliance to Address Threat to 6 Million Bitcoin
cards.b: Nine crypto companies formed the Quantum Alliance to set open standards and prepare for quantum attacks on vulnerable Bitcoin holdings.

per.BTC: Long-term coordination addresses existential quantum risks, though timelines remain distant.

cards.label: COMPLETED CATALYST
cards.missing: Specific mitigation timelines and code implementation steps.

cards.t: Solana Foundation Reschedules Shanghai Event Due to Overwhelming Registration
cards.b: The Solana Foundation postponed its Shanghai event after registrations quadrupled overnight and exceeded local authority limits.

per.SOL: Event delay creates minor operational friction but reflects high local interest.

cards.label: MODERATE CATALYST
